parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description:
The portable account ID.
Limit: The value is a string of 16 characters that can contain digits and lowercase letters.

parameters.name: OwnerAccessInheritable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to share directory permissions. Valid values:
- false (default): does not share directory permissions.
- true: shares directory permissions.
> - This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to Directory and Owner is not empty.
> - The directory has inheritable Owner permissions. Subdirectories and files created under this directory grant read and write permissions to the Owner, even if they are created by other users.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description:
The absolute path of the directory or file.
- The path must start and end with a forward slash (/).
- The path must be 1 to 1,023 characters in length.
- The path must be encoded in UTF-8.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The object type. Valid values:

- File: file.
- Directory: directory.
